editorial:
You meet a wide-eyed stranger who lands in a busy city and starts asking questions that make everyone uncomfortable. PK is an alien who loses his only way home and wanders through everyday life with childlike wonder. Along the way he meets Jaggu, a reporter who helps him, and a powerful godman who may hold the key to his return. The movie mixes comedy, romance, and big ideas about faith and fear, so it feels light but still makes you think.

Aamir Khan carries the film with a funny, warm performance, and Anushka Sharma gives Jaggu real heart. The pacing is lively, with colorful songs and sharp jokes, though some scenes run long and the message can feel heavy-handed. If you enjoy feel-good stories with social commentary, this is a great pick. You can stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture and sound.
endingExplained: In the finale, PK challenges the godman on live TV and proves the stolen remote was sold to him. The godman is forced to return it, and PK also helps Jaggu clear up a painful misunderstanding with Sarfaraz, reuniting the couple. With his device back, PK says goodbye and returns to his planet. The last twist shows he has already started teaching his people about Earth, hinting his questions will keep spreading.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves feel-good stories with humor and heart.
